description: Create a new Scheduled Maintenance Event in OneUptime. Returns the created Scheduled Maintenance Event object with its ID. Use this to add new Scheduled Maintenance Events to your project. Note: projectId is inferred from your API key — you do not need to provide it.

cephClusters.description: List of Ceph clusters affected by this event.

changeMonitorStatusToId.description: Relation to Monitor Status Object ID. The monitors attached to this event change to this status when the event starts, and back to operational when it ends. It can be changed until the event starts.

currentScheduledMaintenanceStateId.description: Scheduled Maintenance State ID. The state the event currently is in.

databaseServers.description: List of databases affected by this event.

description.description: Description of this scheduled event that will show up on Status Page. This is in markdown.

dockerHosts.description: List of Docker hosts affected by this event.

dockerSwarmClusters.description: List of Docker Swarm clusters affected by this event.

enableReminders.description: Should reminder notifications be sent to owners while this scheduled maintenance event is still not complete? Reminders are sent based on the reminder rules configured for this project.

hosts.description: List of hosts affected by this event.

iotFleets.description: List of IoT fleets affected by this event.

isVisibleOnStatusPage.description: Should this incident be visible on the status page?

kubernetesClusters.description: List of Kubernetes clusters affected by this event.

labels.description: Relation to Labels Array where this object is categorized in.

monitors.description: List of monitors attached to this event.

networkSites.description: List of network sites affected by this event. Their descendants are covered too.

nextSubscriberNotificationBeforeTheEvent.description: When will the next notification to subscribers be sent out?

podmanHosts.description: List of Podman hosts affected by this event.

projectId.description: ID of your OneUptime Project in which this object belongs.

proxmoxClusters.description: List of Proxmox clusters affected by this event.

publishOnStatusPageAt.description: When this event first shows on its status pages and their subscribers hear about it. Left empty, it shows as soon as it is created.

sendSubscriberNotificationsOnBeforeTheEv.description: Should subscribers be notified before the event?

services.description: List of services affected by this event.

shouldStatusPageSubscribersBeNotifiedOnE.description: Should subscribers be notified about this event creation?

shouldStatusPageSubscribersBeNotifiedWhe.description: Should subscribers be notified about this event event is changed to ended?
Should subscribers be notified about this event event is changed to ongoing?

statusPages.description: List of status pages to show this event on.

storageArrays.description: List of storage arrays affected by this event.

vmwareVCenters.description: List of vCenters affected by this event.

name: create_scheduled_maintenance_event
title: Create Scheduled Maintenance Event
